oauth.title: OAuth / Ukungena ngenkundla yezokuxhumana
oauth.description: Lungiselela abahlinzeki bokungena ngenkundla yezokuxhumana (Google, Facebook)

google.label: Ukungena nge-Google
google.description: Vumela abasebenzisi ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti yabo ye-Google
google.step1: Vula i-Google Cloud Console bese ukhetha iphrojekthi ekhona, noma udale entsha yalesi sitolo.
google.step2: Ngaphansi kwe-APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, gcwalisa igama lohlelo, i-imeyili yosizo nesizinda esigunyaziwe, bese ushicilela uhlelo. Uma lusahlala ku-Testing, abasebenzisi bokuhlola obabhalile kuphela abangangena.
google.step3: Yiya ku-Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID bese ukhetha i-Web application njengohlobo.
google.step6: Kopisha i-Client ID ne-Client secret kuzinkambu ezingenhla, ulondoloze, bese ucindezela u-Qinisekisa imininingwane. Amaklayenti amasha e-Google angathatha imizuzu embalwa ngaphambi kokuba asebenze.

facebook.label: Ukungena nge-Facebook
facebook.description: Vumela abasebenzisi ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti yabo ye-Facebook
facebook.step1: Vula i-Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create app, bese ukhetha inhloso “Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”.
facebook.step2: Engeza umkhiqizo we-Facebook Login kuhlelo, bese uvula i-Facebook Login → Settings.
facebook.step3: Vula i-Client OAuth login ne-Web OAuth login, bese wengeza lokhu ngaphansi kwe-Valid OAuth Redirect URIs:
facebook.step4: Ku-App settings → Basic, misa i-Site URL ibe
facebook.step4c: ngaphansi kwe-App domains. I-Meta idinga ne-URL yenqubomgomo yobumfihlo ngaphambi kokuba uhlelo lube semoyeni.
facebook.step5: Kopisha i-App ID ne-App Secret kuzinkambu ezingenhla, ulondoloze, bese ucindezela u-Qinisekisa imininingwane.
facebook.step6: Shintsha uhlelo kusuka ku-Development luye ku-Live. Kuze kube yilapho, abantu abanendima kuhlelo kuphela abangangena nge-Facebook.

oauth.envCredentials: Imininingwane yalo mhlinzeki isethwe ngama-environment variables — yivule ukuze isebenze.
oauth.originMismatch: Ubheka ku-{browser}, kodwa ukungena kusebenza nge-{configured}. Bhalisa ama-URL aboniswe ngezansi — noma ukhombise i-BETTER_AUTH_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL kusizinda osisebenzisa ngempela.
oauth.redirectUriHint: Yinamathisele kukhonsoli yomhlinzeki njengoba nje ibonakala — noma yimuphi umehluko, ngisho ne-slash ekugcineni, wenza ukungena kwenqatshwe.
oauth.httpsRequiredGoogle: I-Google yamukela kuphela i-redirect URI ye-HTTPS (okuwukuphela kokuhlukile ngu-http://localhost). Vula leli khasi kusizinda sakho esisebenzayo ngaphambi kokulibhalisa.
oauth.httpsRequiredFacebook: I-Meta yamukela kuphela i-redirect URI ye-HTTPS yomphakathi — i-localhost iyenqatshwa. Vula leli khasi kusizinda sakho esisebenzayo, noma ithanele le-HTTPS, ngaphambi kokulibhalisa.
oauth.verifyHint: Ukuqinisekisa kuhlola i-ID nemfihlo kumhlinzeki. Ukuthi i-redirect URI ibhalisiwe yini kubonakala kuphela ngokungena kwangempela.

storage.minioEndpointHelp: I-URL ye-API ye-MinIO — i-port 9000 ngokuzenzakalelayo. Kufanele ifinyeleleke kule seva.
storage.minioPublicUrlHelp: Lapho iziphequluli zilayisha khona amafayela. Ngokuvamile yiseva efanayo; engeza i-URL ye-CDN noma ye-reverse proxy lapha uma usebenzisa eyodwa.
storage.spacesPublicUrlHelp: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kuhanjiswe ngqo kusuka ku-Space, noma unamathisele i-endpoint ye-CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) ukuze kugcinwe emaphethelweni enethiwekhi.

localRetired.title: Isitoreji sendawo sesiyekiwe
localRetired.body: Amafayela asevele akule seva ayaqhubeka elayisha, kodwa okulayishwa okusha kudinga omunye wabahlinzeki abangezansi. Khetha oyedwa, ufake imininingwane yakhe, bese uvula “Thutha amafayela osuvele unawo” — kunemiyalo kanye nokugcina okumele ukwenze ngaphambi kokuthumela okulandelayo.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: Kudeshibhodi ye-Cloudflare vula i-R2 → Create bucket. Igama layo lifakwa kwi-Igama lebhakede ngenhla.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, imvume Object Read & Write, ekhawulelwe kulelo bhakede. Kopisha zombili izingxenye ku-Access Key ID naku-Secret Access Key ngenhla — imfihlo iboniswa kanye kuphela.
cloudflare_r2.account: Kopisha i-Account ID enezinhlamvu ezingu-32 kubha eseceleni yekhasi le-R2 uyifake ku-R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Ibhakede → Settings → Public access: vula i-subdomain ye-r2.dev noma uxhume idomeyini yakho, bese unamathisela leyo kheli ku-URL yomphakathi.
cloudflare_r2.test: Cindezela u-Hlola uxhumano, bese ulondoloza. Ukuhlola kulayisha ifayela lokuhlola bese ekufunda kabusha nge-public URL, ngakho kuzohluleka uma weqe isinyathelo esandulele.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Ngaphandle kwe-URL yomphakathi sonke isithombe somkhiqizo sibuyisela u-403 kusiphequluli noma imininingwane ibonakala ilungile — amafayela avela ku-endpoint eyimfihlo ye-R2, engafundeki ngaphandle kokungena. Idomeyini yakho ingcono kune-r2.dev: i-CDN ye-Cloudflare iphendula izicelo ezigciniwe ingayikhokhisi ibhakede.

s3.bucket: Dala ibhakede kukhonsoli ye-S3 bese uqaphela isifunda saso — kumele sifane nesifunda esikhethwe ngenhla.
s3.iam: IAM → dala umsebenzisi onokufinyelela kwezinhlelo kanye nenqubomgomo enikeza lezi zenzo kulelo bhakede:
s3.public: Vumela ukufundwa ngumphakathi ngenqubomgomo yebhakede, noma ubeke i-CloudFront phambi kwalo, bese unamathisela ikheli elitholakalayo ku-URL yomphakathi.
s3.test: Namathisela ipheya yezikhiye ngenhla, cindezela u-Hlola uxhumano, bese ulondoloza.
s3.caution: Amabhakede amasha afika i-Block all public access ivuliwe. Yishiye ivuliwe kuphela uma usebenzisa i-CloudFront — uma kungenjalo sonke isithombe esitolo sizobuyisela u-403.

minio.run: Sebenzisa i-MinIO eceleni kohlelo — i-Coolify ne-Dokploy zombili zinesifanekiso sokuchofoza kanye. Faka i-volume ku-/data, ngaphandle kwalokho ukuthunyelwa okulandelayo kuzothatha wonke amafayela alayishiwe.
minio.keys: Vula ikhonsoli ye-MinIO (imbobo 9001 ngokuzenzakalela), dala ibhakede, bese uya ku-Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.fields: I-Endpoint URL yikheli le-API (imbobo 9000), hhayi ikhonsoli. Isifunda singahlala siwu-us-east-1 — i-MinIO ayisinaki. I-URL yomphakathi yilapho iziphequluli zifinyelela khona ibhakede.
minio.caution: Nikeza i-MinIO nge-HTTPS ku-subdomain yayo. Iziphequluli zivimba okuqukethwe okuxubile, ngakho i-endpoint ye-http:// yonakalisa zonke izithombe esitolo se-HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Isikhungo sedatha osikhethayo yiso i-endpoint (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), ngakho khetha esiseduze namakhasimende akho bese ukhetha sona leso sifunda ngenhla.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, bese ukopisha zombili izingxenye ku-Access Key ID naku-Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → misa i-File Listing ibe eyomphakathi, noma uvule i-CDN.
digitalocean.test: Shiya i-URL yomphakathi ingenalutho ukuze unikeze ngqo kusuka ku-Space, noma unamathisele i-endpoint ye-CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) ukuze unikeze usuka onqenqemeni. Bese uhlola uxhumano futhi ulondoloze.
digitalocean.caution: Igama le-Space yilo Igama lebhakede elingenhla, futhi i-Space ayikwazi ukudluliselwa kwesinye isikhungo sedatha kamuva — isifunda sayo simiswa ngesikhathi sokudala.

migration.title: Thutha amafayela osuvele unawo
migration.intro: Ukukhetha umhlinzeki kushintsha kuphela lapho okulayishwa okusha kuya khona. Konke okwalayishwa ngaphambili kuhlala lapho bekukhona futhi kuyaqhubeka kulayisha uze ukuthuthe.
migration.step1: Misa umhlinzeki ngenhla bese ucindezela u-Hlola uxhumano — ukufuduka kulayishela kulokho okulondolozwe lapha.
migration.step2: Thutha imininingwane elondoloziwe uyise esakhiweni somhlinzeki ngamunye. Kuphephile kunoma iyiphi inguqulo, futhi akwenzi lutho uma sekusebenze kanye.
migration.step3: Layisha amafayela asendaweni bese ubhala kabusha ama-URL awo kuyo yonke idathabhesi. Ukusebenza kokuzama kubala wonke amafayela futhi akubhali lutho.
migration.step4: Hlola isitolo nomtapo wemidiya. Akukho lutho olususwa kudiski, ngakho susa amakhophi asendaweni ngesandla lapho izithombe sezivela.
migration.backup: Ngaphambi kokuthumela okulandelayo: uma indlela yakho yokubuyekeza ishintsha ifolda yohlelo — ukulayisha nge-cPanel, ukubhala phezu kwe-zip, isiqukathi esingenayo i-volume — qala ngokukopisha amafayela emidiya uwakhiphe kuseva. Ukushintsha ifolda kuyawasusa.
migration.note: Ifayela elihlulekayo ukulayishwa ligcina i-URL yalo yasendaweni, ngakho ukusebenza okungaphelele kushiya isitolo esisebenzayo esikhundleni sesiphukile. Ukuphinda kuphephile.

storage.privateBucketMissing: Ayikho i-bucket eyimfihlo: amadokhumenti obunikazi, imikhiqizo yedijithali namarisidi ezindleko agcinwa ku-bucket yomphakathi engenhla, lapho noma ubani onekheli lefayela angalivula khona. Engeza i-bucket eyimfihlo, bese usebenzisa i-pnpm db:migrate private-storage ukuze uhambise amafayela asevele egciniwe.
storage.r2PublicUrlMissing: Ngaphandle kwe-URL yomphakathi, amafayela alayishiwe awakwazi ukuboniswa esitolo sakho — ama-URL ezithombe namavidiyo azokhomba ku-endpoint eyimfihlo ye-R2 futhi ahluleke ukulayisha. Ku-Cloudflare Dashboard → R2 → i-bucket yakho → Settings → Public access, vula i-subdomain ye-R2.dev (noma uxhume isizinda sakho) bese unamathisela leyo URL lapha.

channelConnections.title: Ukuxhumana kwe-API ye-Meta
channelConnections.webhookUrlNotPublic: I-Meta yamukela kuphela ikheli lokubuyela le-HTTPS elivulekele wonke umuntu. Vula leli khasi kusizinda sakho olusebenzayo — noma ngomhubhe — ngaphambi kokulibhalisa.

whatsapp.app: Dala uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Meta bese ungeza umkhiqizo we-WhatsApp kulo.
whatsapp.config: Dala ukumisa kwe-Facebook Login for Business okunikeza lezi zimvume, bese ufaka i-ID yakho ku-META_WHATSAPP_CONFIGURATION_ID.
whatsapp.oauth: Kuzilungiselelo zalokho kumisa, engeza isizinda saleli sayithi ku-Allowed Domains for the JavaScript SDK, ne-URL egcwele yaleli khasi ku-Valid OAuth Redirect URIs.
whatsapp.webhook: Ngaphansi kwe-Webhooks, bhalisa ikheli lokubuyela elikhonjiswe kuleli khasi nge-META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN yakho bese ubhalisela lezi zinkambu.
whatsapp.connect: Sebenzisa i-Continue with Facebook, noma ugcwalise ama-ID e-akhawunti nethokheni yokufinyelela kufomu elikuleli khasi.
whatsapp.caution: I-Meta idinga ukuqinisekiswa kwebhizinisi nenombolo yocingo ebhalisiwe ngaphambi kokuba noma ubani ongesiye umsebenzisi wokuhlola akwazi ukukuthumelela umlayezo.

messenger.app: Engeza umkhiqizo we-Messenger kuhlelo olufanayo lwe-Meta bese uxhuma iKhasi le-Facebook oliphethe.
messenger.webhook: Ngaphansi kwe-Webhooks, bhalisa ikheli lokubuyela elikhonjiswe kuleli khasi nge-META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN yakho bese ubhalisela lezi zinkambu.
messenger.token: Khiqiza ithokheni yokufinyelela yekhasi bese uyifaka kufomu elikuleli khasi kanye ne-ID yekhasi.
messenger.caution: Vula izimpendulo ze-Human Agent kuphela ngemva kokuba i-Meta inikeze leyo mvume. Ingeyokusekela ngesandla, ayikaze ibe eyemilayezo ezenzakalelayo noma yokukhangisa.

instagram.professional: Shintshela i-akhawunti ye-Instagram ibe yi-akhawunti yochwepheshe (Business noma Creator).
instagram.page: Yixhume neKhasi le-Facebook oliphethe — i-Instagram Direct ifinyelelwa ngalelo khasi, ngakho lokhu kuyadingeka.
instagram.allowAccess: Kuhlelo lwe-Instagram, vula i-Settings → Messages and story replies → Connected tools → Allow access to messages.
instagram.permissions: Engeza umkhiqizo we-Instagram kuhlelo olufanayo lwe-Meta bese ucela lezi zimvume.
instagram.webhook: Ngaphansi kwe-Webhooks, bhalisa ikheli lokubuyela elikhonjiswe kuleli khasi nge-META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN yakho bese ubhalisela lezi zinkambu.
instagram.connect: Sebenzisa i-Continue with Facebook, noma ugcwalise i-ID ye-akhawunti ye-Instagram nethokheni yokufinyelela yekhasi elixhunyiwe kufomu elikuleli khasi.
instagram.caution: I-META_INSTAGRAM_CONFIGURATION_ID kumele ibe ukumisa kwe-Facebook Login for Business. I-ID engaphansi kwe-Instagram → API setup with Instagram login ingeyomkhiqizo ohlukile, futhi amakhodi ayo ayehluleka ngephutha le-redirect_uri.

telegram.botfather: Vula i-@BotFather ku-Telegram bese uthumela u-/newbot.
